entities.name: Sruta
entities.description: Quiet, skilled craftsperson of Innistrad who joined the ritual to summon the Buried Lord and was killed and consumed by him.

entities.name: Olutio
entities.description: Leader of the small group that tried to summon the Buried Lord.

entities.name: Algli
entities.description: Member of the group who later found Sruta with Liesa.

entities.name: Liesa
entities.description: Arch angel whose return Sruta was partially responsible for.

entities.name: Buried Lord
entities.description: Demon the group tried to summon; killed and consumed Sruta.

events.summary: Sruta takes part in the final ritual to summon the Buried Lord; when it seems to fail she calls Olutio and Algli fools and leaves.
events.quote: she expressed her frustration and disillusionment by calling Olutio and Algli fools

events.summary: The Buried Lord kills and consumes Sruta as Algli and Liesa find her.
events.quote: The Buried Lord killed and consumed Sruta

relations.quote: The Buried Lord killed and consumed Sruta

relations.note: Led the small group of ritualists
relations.quote: led by Olutio and including Algli
